claims: Super Bowl LXI is scheduled for February 14, 2027.
Super Bowl LXI is scheduled at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.
SoFi Stadium is in the Los Angeles area.
Super Bowl LXI will be broadcast by ABC/ESPN.
Super Bowl LXI marks the second Super Bowl hosted at SoFi Stadium.
As of March 2026, the specific teams for Super Bowl LXI have not been officially announced.
As of March 2026, the halftime performers for Super Bowl LXI have not been officially announced.
Ticket packages for Super Bowl LXI are already available through official channels.
Super Bowl LXI will be broadcast by ESPN/ABC (Simulcast).
The host region for Super Bowl LXI is Greater Los Angeles.
Official ticket packages and premium hospitality for Super Bowl LXI are sold through On Location.
Super Bowl LXI will be the ninth time the Los Angeles area has hosted the Super Bowl.
Super Bowl LXI coincides with the 60th anniversary of the first Super Bowl.
